author: Mark Atwood
text: RE-ROLED 2026-05-12 (under three-mode policy-class architecture ratified in AGENTS.md non-negotiable #5; memory pkix-three-mode-policy-architecture-2026-05-12). The previous label 'superseded by PKIX-ncab' was wrong-framed: PKIX-ncab demoted OSCAL from canonical / source-of-truth status, but the shipped emit/parse code in pkix-lint/src/oscal/* did not become defunct. Under the new architecture, OSCAL is one of three modes of policy-class consumption -- specifically, one optional policy-adapter format consumed via the OSCAL Profile JSON path. The shipped code that this epic delivered (.1-.7, .10, .11, .8) is the workspace's OSCAL adapter implementation. It serves the (Industry-forum / vendor policies) mode for sites that have chosen OSCAL as their policy-data format. NOT defunct, NOT superseded -- re-roled from 'workspace canonical format' to 'one supported policy-adapter format among several.' Remaining open child .9 (check_shape convenience API) is unaffected by the re-roling; it sits naturally over the shipped emit/parse code. Title updated to reflect the re-roling. Acceptance criteria from the original Arch 2 reshape (emits OSCAL Assessment Results JSON, consumes OSCAL Catalog/Profile JSON, validates against NIST schema, CHANGELOG entry) all remain valid. AGENTS.md update is part of the three-mode ratification commit (d1f65dc5).
